ex.zh: 能源稽核顯示我們在哪裡浪費電。

ex.en: Wind is a clean energy source.
ex.zh: 風力是乾淨的能源來源。

ex.en: The government supports alternative energy.
ex.zh: 政府支持替代能源。

ex.en: The city plans to use only clean energy.
ex.zh: 這座城市計畫只用潔淨能源。

ex.en: The company buys green energy for its offices.
ex.zh: 公司為辦公室購買綠電。

ex.en: We installed solar panels on the roof.
ex.zh: 我們在屋頂裝了太陽能板。

ex.en: Wind turbines stand along the coast.
ex.zh: 海岸邊立著風力發電機。

ex.en: The dam has a hydroelectric power station.
ex.zh: 水壩有一座水力發電廠。

ex.en: Iceland uses a lot of geothermal energy.
ex.zh: 冰島大量使用地熱能。

ex.en: We need to rely less on fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 我們需要減少依賴化石燃料。

ex.en: The plant runs on natural gas.
ex.zh: 這座電廠使用天然氣。

ex.en: The country still burns coal for electricity.
ex.zh: 這個國家仍燒煤發電。

ex.en: Nuclear power produces little carbon.
ex.zh: 核能的碳排放很少。

ex.en: The storm damaged the power grid.
ex.zh: 暴風雨損壞了電網。

ex.en: Electric vehicles are becoming cheaper.
ex.zh: 電動車越來越便宜。

ex.en: There is a charging station in the parking lot.
ex.zh: 停車場有充電站。

ex.en: This car has excellent fuel efficiency.
ex.zh: 這台車燃油效率極佳。

ex.en: The UN promotes sustainable development.
ex.zh: 聯合國推動永續發展。

ex.en: The farm follows sustainable practices.
ex.zh: 這座農場採用永續作法。

ex.en: The new office is a certified green building.
ex.zh: 新辦公室是認證綠建築。

ex.en: Look for the eco-label when shopping.
ex.zh: 購物時請認明環保標章。

ex.en: Conservation efforts have saved the species.
ex.zh: 保育工作拯救了這個物種。

ex.en: Deforestation is a major environmental problem.
ex.zh: 森林砍伐是重大環境問題。

ex.en: The company funds reforestation projects.
ex.zh: 公司資助重新造林計畫。

ex.en: The tiger is an endangered species.
ex.zh: 老虎是瀕危物種。

ex.en: Rainforests have rich biodiversity.
ex.zh: 雨林擁有豐富的生物多樣性。

ex.en: Pollution damages the ecosystem.
ex.zh: 污染破壞生態系。

ex.en: The earthquake was a terrible natural disaster.
ex.zh: 那場地震是可怕的天災。

ex.en: The drought hurt the farmers.
ex.zh: 乾旱重創農民。

ex.en: The flood destroyed many homes.
ex.zh: 洪水摧毀了許多房屋。

ex.en: Heavy rain caused flooding downtown.
ex.zh: 大雨造成市區淹水。

ex.en: The wildfire spread quickly.
ex.zh: 野火迅速蔓延。

ex.en: The building survived the earthquake.
ex.zh: 這棟大樓挺過了地震。

ex.en: The new climate policy targets clean energy.
ex.zh: 新的氣候政策以潔淨能源為目標。

ex.en: Global temperatures are rising.
ex.zh: 全球氣溫正在上升。

ex.en: The bank offers online banking services.
ex.zh: 這家銀行提供網路銀行服務。

ex.en: Commercial banks lend money to businesses.
ex.zh: 商業銀行放款給企業。

ex.en: He works for an investment bank in New York.
ex.zh: 他在紐約的投資銀行工作。

ex.en: Retail banking serves individual customers.
ex.zh: 零售銀行業務服務個人客戶。

ex.en: Private banking is for wealthy clients.
ex.zh: 私人銀行服務富裕客戶。

ex.en: The branch manager approved the loan.
ex.zh: 分行經理核准了貸款。

ex.en: A loan officer will review your application.
ex.zh: 放款專員會審查你的申請。

ex.en: A customer service representative will help you.
ex.zh: 客服專員會協助您。

ex.en: Only the account holder can make changes.
ex.zh: 只有帳戶持有人可以變更。

ex.en: The couple opened a joint account.
ex.zh: 這對夫妻開了聯名帳戶。

ex.en: You need a business account for company payments.
ex.zh: 公司付款需要公司帳戶。

ex.en: Your salary is paid into your current account.
ex.zh: 薪水會匯入你的活期帳戶。

ex.en: A deposit account earns interest.
ex.zh: 存款帳戶可以賺利息。

ex.en: Fixed deposits pay higher interest.
ex.zh: 定期存款利息較高。

ex.en: She put her savings in a one-year time deposit.
ex.zh: 她把存款放一年期定存。

ex.en: The bank raised its savings rate.
ex.zh: 銀行調高了儲蓄利率。

ex.en: The card has an annual percentage rate of 18 percent.
ex.zh: 這張卡年利率 18%。

ex.en: Keep a minimum balance of $500 to avoid fees.
ex.zh: 保持最低餘額 500 美元可免手續費。

ex.en: There is no monthly fee for this account.
ex.zh: 這個帳戶沒有月費。

ex.en: A small service fee applies.
ex.zh: 需收少許服務費。

ex.en: Each transfer has a $1 transaction fee.
ex.zh: 每筆轉帳收 1 美元手續費。

ex.en: Using another bank's machine has an ATM fee.
ex.zh: 使用他行提款機要收手續費。

ex.en: He paid an overdraft fee last month.
ex.zh: 他上個月付了透支費。

ex.en: Overdraft protection prevents declined payments.
ex.zh: 透支保護能避免付款被拒。

ex.en: Check your bank statement every month.
ex.zh: 每個月檢查你的銀行對帳單。

ex.en: Your monthly statement is available online.
ex.zh: 你的月結單可在線上查看。

ex.en: Check your account balance at the ATM.
ex.zh: 在提款機查詢帳戶餘額。

ex.en: Your available balance is $1,200.
ex.zh: 你的可用餘額是 1,200 美元。

ex.en: Salaries are paid by direct deposit.
ex.zh: 薪水以直接入帳方式支付。

ex.en: Set up automatic payment for your bills.
ex.zh: 為帳單設定自動扣款。

ex.en: I pay rent by standing order.
ex.zh: 我用定期轉帳付房租。

ex.en: Bill payment can be made online.
ex.zh: 帳單可以線上繳費。

ex.en: An online transfer takes only seconds.
ex.zh: 網路轉帳只要幾秒鐘。

ex.en: International transfers take two to three days.
ex.zh: 國際匯款需要兩到三天。

ex.en: Please wire the money by Friday.
ex.zh: 請在週五前電匯款項。

ex.en: Enter the bank's routing number.
ex.zh: 請輸入銀行代碼。
